crossings.name: from far below to far above
to nothing left, and nothing again
at the threshold exactly from above
a stamp not newer is no reading
outside of what can be used
memory from before, over the threshold

an automatic switcher owns the notices of Claude and Codex, and of no other tool
an interval set longer, and many windows in one look
a window dated with nothing breaks the whole look on the Python Host
a push that reaches no phone is settled with what became of it, and not tried again
nothing left with a recovery asked: what the recovery answers where none runs
